content: {"phoneNote":"Deliberately typographic, calm and legible, but the hero's 'Pošljite dokument' is a weak underlined link rather than a clear primary action and the contact block makes the first screen read as one long list.","desktopNote":"Hero and contact column work well, but the pricing table stops at half width leaving the right half of the page empty, and the oversized 'Prevajanje Kolar' footer wordmark competes with the hero headline.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Make 'Pošljite dokument' a proper filled button in the hero and give the pricing table full width on desktop (or place the surcharge note beside it) to kill the dead right half.","Shrink the footer wordmark to a modest size and merge the dark CTA band and footer so address/phone are not repeated three times (hero, footer, fixed bar).","Tighten vertical rhythm: trim the empty band under the hero and above the dark CTA on desktop, and reduce the gap between pricing and services on phone."],"blockers":[]}
